## What is this Handbook?

Welcome to the **Dummy Guide to Having a Relationship with Chris**! Whether you are a partner, close friend, or curious bystander, this handbook exists to decode the mysteries, daily routines, communication protocols, and occasional error messages of the complex organism known as **Chris**.

::: {.comic-grid}
::: {.comic-panel}
::: {.comic-caption}
PANEL 1: THE MISSION
:::
### Why Read This?
Human relationships rarely come with an instruction booklet—until now. This book combines the straightforward wit of the classic *For Dummies* guides with the dynamic energy of comic strips. 
:::

::: {.comic-panel}
::: {.comic-caption}
PANEL 2: 100% MODULAR
:::
### Ready for Input!
This book is currently set up as a **blank calibration form and scaffold**. The structure, layout, and comic panels are ready—all you need to do is plug in your personalized truths!
:::

::: {.comic-panel}
::: {.comic-caption}
PANEL 3: PRINT & SHARE
:::

Read it online anytime on GitHub Pages, or export and print the PDF copy to keep on the nightstand for rapid emergency consultations!

## Guide Icons & Decoding Signals

Throughout this handbook, you will encounter classic *Dummies* and comic callouts designed to keep you safe in the field:

::: {.callout-tip}
## 💡 Pro-Tip / Cheat Code
Actionable advice to maximize relationship harmony, unlock bonus conversation points, or speed up recovery time.
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
## ⚠️ Danger Zone / Tread Lightly
High-risk behaviors, phrases to avoid, and critical hangry indicators. Proceed with extreme caution.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## 🤓 Technical Stuff / Firmware Specs
Detailed explanations of Chris's background cognitive processes, hardware specs, and quirk architectures.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
## 📌 Remember / The Golden Rule
Core tenets and non-negotiables that form the bedrock of successful day-to-day coexistence.
:::
